```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[1, ]
names(first_fire)
```

```{r}
first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][1, 1, ]
first_coordinate
```

```{r}
features_tbl <- tibble(features = raw$features)
features_tbl
```

```{r}
expanded_features <- features_tbl |>
  unnest_wider(features)
expanded_features
```

```{r}
expanded_properties <- expanded_features |>
  unnest_wider(properties)
expanded_properties
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- expanded_properties |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_log10()

fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned per Year",
    x = "Fire year",
    y = "Total acres burned",
    caption = "Source: wildfires GeoJSON dataset"
  )

top_states <- fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarise(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
top_states
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(x) mean(x[[1]][, , 1], na.rm = TRUE)),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(x) mean(x[[1]][, , 2], na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires |>
  count(agency) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = agency, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing agency",
    y = "Number of fires"
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    lng = map(geometry_coordinates, \(x) as.numeric(x[[1]][1, , 1])),
    lat = map(geometry_coordinates, \(x) as.numeric(x[[1]][1, , 2]))
  )

map <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(largest_fires))) {
  map <- map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = largest_fires$lng[[i]],
      lat = largest_fires$lat[[i]],
      popup = paste0(
        "<strong>", largest_fires$incident[[i]], "</strong><br>",
        "Year: ", largest_fires$fire_year[[i]], "<br>",
        "Acreage: ", format(largest_fires$gis_acres[[i]], big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
}

map |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$lng)),
    lat1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$lat)),
    lng2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$lng)),
    lat2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$lat))
  )
```
